items.t: Trading vs investing: what is the difference and where should a beginner start?
items.x: Investing means owning for years; trading means betting on short moves. The real numbers on who wins, the costs, and why beginners should start with investing.

items.t: What is a stock? Explained in plain words, step by step

items.t: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) on November 30: what the index exit means

items.t: What's happening with FET (Artificial Superintelligence Alliance)? +12% rebound

items.x: Why is Nutanix stock down? NTNX fell 15% to $46.30 on Nov 25 after CEO Rajiv Ramaswami said he will step down and the full-year revenue outlook stayed flat.

items.x: Why is the stock market up today? On Black Friday, Nov 27, the Nasdaq closed up 2.3% and the S&P 500 1.6%, capping a ~5% week as chip stocks rebounded.

items.x: Why is gold up today? Gold futures rose 2.7% to about $3,662 and silver jumped 8% on November 27, a bargain-hunting rebound in thin post-Thanksgiving trade.
